art_direction: Warm, immersive otherworldly coastal settlement; appealing human travelers; physically coherent organic architecture
production_stages: Human scale and whole-bay navigation greybox
Closed architectural shells with functioning doors and interiors
Character base mesh, clothing, facial topology and rig
Per-asset automatic QA and inspected multi-angle captures
GLB export, separate re-import and engine validation
release_gates: No detached head, neck, limbs or clothing poke-through
No unintended open roof-wall seam or floating window
No placeholder primitive silhouettes presented as finished fantasy scenery
Approach, doorway, seating and walkable collision match visible geometry
No persistent promotional copy over the playfield
Actual engine captures satisfy composition, lighting, materials and detail in that order
